_comment: Production alert rules for the Grafana Cloud stack (IFC-032). Applied by tools/scripts/grafana/apply-alert-rules.mjs through the Grafana provisioning API (workflow: grafana-alert-rules.yml). Metrics are the span metrics Grafana Cloud generates from our OTLP traces: traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service, span_name, span_kind, status_code} and the traces_spanmetrics_latency histogram (seconds). Routed by the default notification policy to the owner's email contact point.
